property_summary: After any call SetMinSum(v), MinSum must equal exactly v (SetMinSum overwrites); the mutant accumulates, so MinSum becomes v2+v1 and violates the rule for repeated calls with nonzero values.
change_summary: Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = MinSum + _val;` so the stored value accumulates instead of being assigned, changing the observable MinSum.
